currencyNote: All model prices are EUR per week, boat only (bareboat list price before skipper, extras, mandatory end-cleaning/transit-log fees and before early-booking/last-minute discounts), Croatia basis, for a typical boat roughly 1-5 years old. low = April / late October, shoulder = May-June and September, peak = July-August. Rounded to the nearest 50. Evidence is mostly 2026-season asking prices from aggregator listings (yacht-rent.com, 12knots, happycharter, boatbookings, yachtico, samboat, nautal), read from search snippets because direct fetches were blocked. Destination multipliers apply to the Croatia price for the same season tier. BVI multipliers are expressed in USD: the BVI USD weekly price = Croatia EUR price x multiplier (converted at 1.08 USD per EUR; the EUR-equivalent factor is given in the note). Tropical destinations (BVI, Seychelles, Thailand) have flatter seasonal curves than the Mediterranean, so their low-season prices are relatively higher than a single multiplier implies. Tropical destinations use seasonFactors (share of the peak price) instead of the Croatian low/shoulder curve.

croatia.note: Baseline. Saturday-to-Saturday. Many boats are bookable Nov-Mar at below-April prices, but most fleets don't operate then, so those months are marked closed. Late June is increasingly priced at or near peak (e.g. Lagoon 42 EUR 7,200-9,150 from 20 Jun), and the first week of September is often still near peak.

SO 440 Mallorca is EUR 4,000-6,500 (2023) and EUR 2,348-6,450 (2020), against Croatia's EUR 2,350-5,150. Oceanis 51.1 Mallorca 2025 is EUR 6,500-10,000. A few Palma fleets operate year-round, but most bases run April-October. Sources: yacht-rent.com/spain/51170-lagoon-42-balearic-islands, /spain/62469-lagoon-42-mallorca, /spain/46243-sun-odyssey-440-mallorca.

turkey.note: Turkey's season curve is flatter than Croatia's: peak is slightly lower and spring/autumn are dearer. Lagoon 42 Marmaris/Gocek 2023-2024 is EUR 7,950-8,200 peak (one Marmaris boat holds EUR 7,950 from 4 Jul to 31 Oct). Lagoon 40 2023 is EUR 5,300 in early April and EUR 5,800 from 25 Apr-6 Jun. SO 440 Marmaris 2022 is EUR 4,540 from 4 Jul-3 Oct, and Oceanis 46.1 Gocek 2020 EUR 4,900 from 18 Jul-29 Aug. The 0.95 is a whole-season blend; the true April figure is about 1.2-1.5 and August about 0.9. Sources: yacht-rent.com/turkey/42853-lagoon-42-marmaris, /turkey/45083-lagoon-42-göcek, /turkey/42847-lagoon-40-mediterranean, /turkey/50698-sun-odyssey-440-marmaris, /turkey/49121-oceanis-46.1-göcek.

Treated as roughly Croatia -5%. Sources: bebluesailing.com Kotor listings, 12knots.com/en/yacht-charter/lagoon-42-lyubushka-65241/, 12knots.com/en/yacht-charter/bavaria-cruiser-46-lavanta-65175/.

bvi.note: These multipliers give a USD price: BVI USD = Croatia EUR x multiplier. Converted at 1.08 USD/EUR, the EUR-equivalent factors are about 1.15 for catamarans and 1.35 for monohulls. Lagoon 42 Tortola 2023 is EUR 5,966-8,522. A 2020 Lagoon 42 is EUR 7,076 from 10 Jul-1 Nov 2026 and EUR 10,026 over Christmas/New Year (18 Dec-5 Jan). Happycharter shows EUR 6,490-11,570. SO 440 Tortola 2024 is EUR 5,206-7,563, against Croatia's EUR 2,350-5,150, so BVI monohulls are relatively dear. The price curve is flat: low season is about 70-80% of peak (Croatia is about 40%), so a straight multiplier undershoots BVI's August-October prices. August-October is hurricane season; some fleet managers close or thin their fleets in September-October, so consider marking September closed. Christmas/New Year weeks carry a further premium of about 15-20%. Prices from the owner-operated Moorings/Sunsail fleets run higher than these aggregator prices. Sources: yacht-rent.com/caribbean/66192-lagoon-42-tortola, /caribbean/64332-lagoon-42-tortola, /caribbean/64357-sun-odyssey-440-tortola, boatbookings.com/yacht_charter/bvi_catamaran_charter.php. Multipliers converted to EUR terms (USD 1.25/1.45 at 1.08 USD per EUR).

seychelles.note: Mainly a catamaran destination; the monohull multiplier is estimated because there are few monohulls. Lagoon 42 Mahe: one listing shows EUR 6,900 in early January and EUR 5,000 from 2 May-3 Oct 2026; another runs EUR 2,600-7,000 with the cheapest tier late May-late September; older boats EUR 4,300 low / EUR 9,000 high; Happycharter EUR 5,900-9,900. Lagoon 46 is EUR 6,400-13,000. The peak is about Croatia level or slightly below, while the low season is dearer than Croatia's April. Sources disagree on high-season months: listing prices are highest at Christmas/New Year and lowest during the SE trade-wind months (Jun-Sep), but some guides call Jul-Aug high because of European holidays. Sources: yacht-rent.com/seychelles-charter/65727-lagoon-42-mahe, boatbookings.com/yacht/lagoon-42-bareboat-catamaran-pid31248, koek.sc/seychelles-sailing-guide/seychelles-sailing-costs.

thailand.note: Phuket Lagoon 42 tiers are consistent across three 2018-2021 boats: about EUR 10,740-11,208 over late Dec-early Jan, EUR 9,648 from January to mid-March, EUR 7,980 from mid-March to April (Yachtico EUR 9,017 for 14 Mar-29 Apr 2026, incl. mandatory costs) and EUR 4,410-4,991 for May-October. Against Croatia that is about 1.15 at peak, 1.25 in shoulder and 1.3 in low; 1.2 is the blend. The monohull fleet is small and data thin, so the monohull figure is estimated. Oceans-Evasion averages put sailboats at about 80-85% of catamaran prices, so monohulls are relatively dear compared with Croatia. The NE monsoon (Nov-Apr) is the sailing season; the SW monsoon (May-Oct) brings rougher west-coast seas. Sources: yacht-rent.com/thailand-charter/46128-lagoon-42-phuket, /thailand-charter/46127-lagoon-42-phuket, /thailand-charter/41618-lagoon-42-phuket, yachtico.com/charters-3zrx, oceans-evasion.com/uk/boat-hire/thailand/phuket.
